           USNEA BARBATA

         Tree-moss


Is a remedy in some forms of congestive headache; sunstroke.



Head.--  Bursting feeling,   as if
        temples would burst, or the eyes burst out of the sockets  . Throbbing carotids.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Glonoine;
        Bellad  .



Dose.--  Tincture, drop doses.
